title: Crispy Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with juicy chicken, crispy vegetables, and a hint of Turkish spice.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
3. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
5. Add the bell peppers, onions, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
6. Add the Turkish red pepper flakes to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
7. Stir in the cooked chicken and cook until heated through.
8. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
9. Serve the chicken and vegetables over cooked rice.
10. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
